title: Jeff Probable NDE 5255
content: All I remember since I was no longer experiencing amnesia, was that there was very bright light and everything was white, very bright white. Nothing else. I remember a sheet covered my whole body, head and all.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Uncertain AccidentDirect head injury 'Car accident, my car door was hit by someone going 40+ mph. I ended up with amnesia, broken hip & 3 fractures of my pelvis.' 'Illness, trauma or other condition not considered life threatening' Head injury.
elements.How did your highest level of consciousn: Less consciousness and alertness than normal Very little.
elements.Did time seem to speed up or slow down?: Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning Might have been due to the accident but I wasn't in pain though my body was broken up. I just could not get over the bright light.
elements.Did you seem to be aware of things going: Yes, and the facts have been checked out
elements.Did you encounter or become aware of any: No Bummer, would love to have.
elements.Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a br: A light clearly of mystical or other-worldly origin
elements.What emotions did you feel during the ex: Could not believe how bright white the light was. They had put a sheet over me thinking I was dead I guess.
elements.Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity: I felt united or one with the world
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: My past flashed before me, out of my control
elements.Did you come to a border or point of no: I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will
elements.God, Spiritual and Religion: point of no return? I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will God, Spiritual and Religion
elements.What is your religion now?: Moderate 'Moderately religious, I do attend mass. I am extremely spiritual.'
elements.Did you seem to encounter a mystical bei: I encountered a definite being, or a voice clearly of mystical or unearthly origin
elements.Concerning our Earthly lives other than: ally saw them Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion
elements.After the NDE: tionships changed specifically because of your experience? Uncertain After the NDE
elements.Was the experience difficult to express: Uncertain Might be due to head injury.
elements.Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or: Uncertain I just became very interested in the above.
elements.What did you believe about the reality o: Experience was definitely real The bright white light and amnesia.
elements.What do you believe about the reality of: Experience was probably real It's what I remember.
